summary: GE HealthCare said Monday it has agreed to acquire Sofie Biosciences for $945 million in cash to expand its reach in the U.S. radiopharmaceutical industry. Sofie Biosciences is a contract manufacturing organization for positron emission tomography radiopharmaceuticals, radioactive drugs that are used in medical imaging tests to visualize metabolic and molecular activity and to treat a range of diseases. The deal gives GE HealthCare a U.S. manufacturing and distribution footprint for F18-labeled PET products, which have a 110-minute half-life and require time-sensitive production and distribution, BTIG analyst Ryan Zimmerman said in a note to clients.
